senses.en: The third month of the year, between February and April.
The fifth month of the year, between April and June.

ex.en: Our school trip is in May.
ex.zh: 我们的学校旅行在五月。

ex.en: Many cities hold outdoor festivals in May as the weather becomes warmer.
ex.zh: 随着天气变暖，许多城市在五月举办户外节庆活动。

entry.tip: 月份首字母大写；表示在五月用 in May。
